summary: Two follow-up commits, each re-checked by the reviewer who raised its items. Report a bug (room reserved for the corner button at a page's end on phones; the action row brought into view after a refused send; the error tied to its field and announced again on a repeat; read-only fields dimmed; focus to Choose file after removing the attachment; the attach buttons named by their own words; copy and docs say send): lows-only, every item resolved, nothing regressed. Admin (the second read after a close mid-match takes no focus and cannot land over a newer one; 'about the slowest'): lows-only, all three resolved. Open lows: the reserved space is dropped under every panel so a phone page jumps; nothing is reserved from 768px; four fixed-text refusals are not re-announced; the repeat relies on a trailing no-break space; a placeholder at 3.2:1 during a send. Admin: an older read's failure can show an error over a newer list; a local accept can be undone on screen by a read in flight; the title page's reads are ordered only within one close; the focus rule's ordering is unpinned.
